slides.title: Zebra

slides.title: Panda

slides.title: Penguin
slides.transcript: The penguin goes waddle, waddle, splash!

slides.transcript: The owl says hoo! Hoo, hoo!

slides.transcript: The cat says meow! Meow, meow!
